texts.Welcome_Text: This is a minimalist, single layer application startup template for the ABP Framework.
texts.Name: Name
texts.AreYouSureToDelete: Are you sure you want to delete this item?
texts.Permission:Saham.Zones.Manage: Manage closed zones and intake pause
texts.Permission:Saham.Compensation.Credit: Credit compensation up to the limit
texts.Permission:Saham.Pricing.Manage: Manage delivery fees and driver pay
texts.Saham:InvalidStateTransition: This action is not allowed now (order is {from}).
texts.Saham:IdempotencyKeyRequired: The Idempotency-Key header is required for this request.
texts.Saham:IdempotencyConflict: This Idempotency-Key was already used with different data.
texts.Saham:RequestInProgress: The same request is still being processed.
texts.Saham:OtpTooManyRequests: Please wait {seconds} seconds before requesting a new code.
texts.Saham:OtpExpired: The code has expired. Request a new one.
texts.Saham:OtpLocked: Too many wrong attempts. Request a new code.
texts.Saham:PhoneAlreadyRegistered: This phone number is already registered.
texts.Saham:CannotChangeOwnRoles: You cannot change your own account or roles.
texts.Saham:LastOwnerCannotBeRemoved: At least one active owner must remain.
texts.Saham:NotRestaurantStaff: Your account is not linked to a restaurant.
texts.Saham:InvalidRestaurantStaffRole: A restaurant manager can only create kitchen or cashier accounts.
texts.Sms:LoginCode: Your Saham login code is {0}. Do not share it.
texts.Setting:Saham.Orders.RestaurantAutoCance: Auto-cancel when restaurant does not respond (minutes)
texts.Setting:Saham.Orders.ItemDecisionMinutes: Customer decision time for unavailable item (minutes)
texts.Setting:Saham.Drivers.StaleMinutes: Incident when driver location is stale after (minutes)
texts.Setting:Saham.Cash.OverdueHour: Hour to block drivers with overdue cash
texts.Saham:InvalidServiceArea: The service area must be a valid polygon of at least 3 points.
texts.Saham:InvalidCommissionRate: The commission rate must be between 0% and 100%.
texts.Saham:InvalidPrepMinutes: Preparation time must be between {min} and {max} minutes.
texts.Saham:InvalidPauseUntil: The reopening time must be in the future.
texts.Saham:PauseReasonRequired: A reason is required to pause a restaurant.
texts.Saham:InvalidOpeningHours: Opening hours are invalid or overlapping.
texts.Saham:MenuCategoryNotInRestaurant: The section does not belong to this restaurant.
texts.Saham:AddressDescriptionTooShort: Describe the address with at least {minLength} characters (nearby landmarks).
texts.Saham:AddressOutsideServiceArea: Delivery is not available at this location.
texts.Saham:InvalidPricingTiers: Distance bands must start at 0 and reach the maximum distance without gaps or overlaps.
texts.Saham:PricingPlanNotEditable: Only a draft plan can be changed. Create a new plan from the active one.
texts.Saham:NoActivePricingPlan: Delivery is not available in this city yet.
texts.Saham:ItemUnavailable: An item in your cart is no longer available.
texts.Saham:RestaurantClosed: The restaurant is closed now. You can schedule the order.
texts.Saham:BelowMinOrder: The minimum order is {minOrder} IQD. Add {missing} IQD more.
texts.Saham:AddressOutOfRange: We do not deliver farther than {maxKm} km from the restaurant.
texts.Saham:InvalidScheduleTime: Choose a time at least {minLeadMinutes} minutes ahead, within {maxDays} days, during the restaurant's hours.
texts.Saham:QuoteExpired: Prices may have changed. Please review the order again.
texts.Saham:QuoteAlreadyUsed: This quote was already used for an order.
texts.Saham:PriceChanged: Prices or availability changed. Please review the new total: {newAmountDue} IQD.
texts.Saham:WalletNotAvailable: Wallet payment is not available yet. Please pay cash.
texts.Saham:CashNotAllowed: Cash payment is disabled on your account after two undelivered orders.
texts.Saham:CashTenderedTooLow: The banknote must cover the amount due ({amountDue} IQD).
texts.Saham:CustomerCannotCancel: The restaurant has already accepted the order. Contact support to cancel.
texts.Saham:OrderOnHold: The order is waiting for the customer's decision on an unavailable item.
texts.Saham:NoItemDecisionPending: There is no decision waiting on this order.
texts.Saham:OrderItemNotFound: Select items that are still in the order.
texts.Saham:NotADriver: This account is not registered as a driver.
texts.Saham:DriverAlreadyRegistered: You are already registered as a driver.
texts.Saham:DriverNotApproved: Your account is not approved yet.
texts.Saham:DriverHasActiveOrders: You cannot go offline while you have an order.
texts.Saham:DriverNotAvailable: The driver is not approved or not available.
texts.Saham:DriverCashBlocked: The driver is blocked from cash orders until he hands over his cash.
texts.Saham:DriverAtCapacity: The driver already has the maximum number of orders.
texts.Saham:DriverDocumentsIncomplete: All three documents must be accepted before approval.
texts.Saham:DocumentInvalidType: Upload a JPG, PNG or PDF file.
texts.Saham:DocumentTooLarge: The file must not exceed {maxMb} MB.
texts.Saham:DocumentAlreadyAccepted: This document has already been accepted.
texts.Saham:InvalidDriverReviewState: This document has already been reviewed.
texts.Saham:OfferNotPending: This offer is no longer open.
texts.Saham:OrderAlreadyAssigned: The order has already been assigned to a driver.
texts.Saham:OrderNotDispatchable: The order cannot be assigned now.
texts.Saham:NoActiveAssignment: The order has no driver to release.
texts.Saham:AssignmentAlreadyPickedUp: The driver has already picked up the order.
